title: Judge orders Trump to give deposition in BBC lawsuit by December 11
detail: A judge ordered President Trump to sit for a deposition in his lawsuit against the BBC by December 11, The Hindu reported on Oct 23.

media.caption: Judge orders Trump to give deposition in BBC lawsuit

title: Trump invokes the Defense Production Act to boost oil production
detail: A headline carried via Google News reports that President Trump invoked the Defense Production Act to boost US oil production. Only the headline was available at scan time; details and the originating outlet are unverified pending follow-up.
